nodes.label: Sky Detectors
nodes.full_label: Sky Detectors
nodes.catchy_title: Can UFO Detectors Make Sightings Scientific?
nodes.summary: Automated instrumented UFO detectors are fixed or portable sensor systems designed to watch the sky continuously, detect unusual aerial events without relying on a human witness, and record enough supporting data to make later analysis possible. In today’s terminology, the target is usually called UAP, or unidentified anomalous phenomena, rather than UFO.

nodes.label: Acoustics
nodes.full_label: Can Sound Help Identify Sky Objects? | Automated Instrument
nodes.catchy_title: Can Sound Help Identify Sky Objects?
nodes.summary: Microphones can help distinguish silent lights, aircraft noise, drones, fireworks, and nearby ground activity.

nodes.label: Aircraft Noise
nodes.full_label: Does the Engine Fit the Light? | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: Does the Engine Fit the Light?
nodes.summary: Aircraft sounds arrive late and from earlier positions, so audio must be matched to video with timing and geometry.

nodes.label: Audio Setup
nodes.full_label: What Makes Sky Audio Trustworthy? | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: What Makes Sky Audio Trustworthy?
nodes.summary: A useful sky-station microphone setup needs calibration, time stamps, weather context and enough recording before and after each event.

nodes.label: Drone Buzz
nodes.full_label: Can a Buzz Point to a Drone? | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: Can a Buzz Point to a Drone?
nodes.summary: Multiple microphones can turn a vague buzz into a bearing that can be compared with a camera track.

nodes.label: Fireworks
nodes.full_label: Was the Flash Just Fireworks? | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: Was the Flash Just Fireworks?
nodes.summary: Fireworks can mimic sky flashes, but their impulse patterns and ground direction often reveal a local source.

nodes.label: Meteor Sound
nodes.full_label: The Delayed Boom After a Meteor | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: The Delayed Boom After a Meteor
nodes.summary: Very low-frequency sound can arrive after a bright meteor and help separate a distant shock event from a nearby aircraft or drone.

nodes.label: Silent Lights
nodes.full_label: When a Quiet UFO Is Not Silent | Automated Instrument 521443 Acoustic Sensors
nodes.catchy_title: When a Quiet UFO Is Not Silent
nodes.summary: A silent-looking light is not automatically strange because distance, delay and background noise can hide ordinary sound.

nodes.label: ADS B
nodes.full_label: How Aircraft Tracking Filters UAP Alerts | Automated Instrument
nodes.catchy_title: How Aircraft Tracking Filters UAP Alerts
nodes.summary: Aircraft tracking data helps detectors decide whether a bright moving object is unusual or just poorly recognized traffic.

nodes.catchy_title: Should UAP Stations Trust Flight Trackers?

nodes.label: Decision Rules
nodes.full_label: When Aircraft Data Should Close a Case | Automated Instrument 521443 Adsb Aircraft Contex
nodes.catchy_title: When Aircraft Data Should Close a Case

nodes.catchy_title: The Airliners That Test UAP Detectors

nodes.catchy_title: When No ADS B Match Misleads
nodes.summary: A missing ADS-B match can reflect coverage, equipage, filtering or timing limits rather than proof that a light was not an aircraft.

nodes.label: Timing Errors
nodes.full_label: Why Seconds Matter in UAP Footage | Automated Instrument 521443 Adsb Aircraft Contex
nodes.catchy_title: Why Seconds Matter in UAP Footage

nodes.label: Track Projection
nodes.full_label: How Aircraft Tracks Land in Video | Automated Instrument 521443 Adsb Aircraft Contex
nodes.catchy_title: How Aircraft Tracks Land in Video
nodes.summary: Matching aircraft to video means turning reported positions into image locations, not just checking a separate flight map.

nodes.label: Baselines
nodes.full_label: Why Normal Sky Data Matters Most | Automated Instrument
nodes.catchy_title: Why Normal Sky Data Matters Most
nodes.summary: Knowing what normally happens above a site is the key to recognizing what is genuinely unusual there.

nodes.catchy_title: What a 90 Day Sky Watch Can Learn

nodes.label: Low Horizon
nodes.full_label: Why the Horizon Creates So Many False Mysteries | Automated Instrument 521443 Baseline Sky Data
nodes.catchy_title: Why the Horizon Creates So Many False Mysteries
nodes.summary: Low-elevation lights are where aircraft, glare, distance, and light pollution most often turn ordinary traffic into puzzling tracks.

nodes.catchy_title: When Ordinary Aircraft Slip Through the Net

nodes.catchy_title: Why Repeating Satellite Tracks Matter

nodes.catchy_title: The Baseline Should Record the Detector Too

nodes.catchy_title: Weather Can Change the Detector Before the Sky

nodes.catchy_title: What Extra Sensors Actually Add

nodes.catchy_title: Should Sky Tracking Software Be Open?

nodes.catchy_title: The Outdoor Problems That Break Sky Detectors

nodes.label: Calibration

nodes.catchy_title: Why UFO Detectors Need Ordinary Planes

nodes.catchy_title: Why matched planes should not just disappear

nodes.catchy_title: The tiny timing error that can fake mystery

nodes.catchy_title: What Galileo learned from ordinary planes

nodes.label: Missed Planes
nodes.full_label: What missed planes reveal about UAP detectors | Automated Instrument 521443 Aircraft Calibration
nodes.catchy_title: What missed planes reveal about UAP detectors
nodes.summary: Failure to detect ordinary aircraft is useful evidence because it exposes weather, range, size and software limits before rare events are judged.

nodes.label: Moving Targets

nodes.catchy_title: How planes turn pixels into sky measurements
nodes.summary: Known aircraft can turn a sky camera from a recorder into a measuring instrument by tying pixels to real directions and times.

nodes.label: Weather Tests
nodes.full_label: How bad weather tests sky cameras | Automated Instrument 521443 Aircraft Calibration
nodes.catchy_title: How bad weather tests sky cameras
nodes.summary: Routine planes let a detector measure how fog, rain, haze, twilight and humidity change what its cameras can actually see.

nodes.label: Edge Computer
nodes.full_label: Why UAP Detectors Need Computers On Site | Automated Instrument
nodes.catchy_title: Why UAP Detectors Need Computers On Site
nodes.summary: Automated stations need local computing to trigger cameras, preserve data, and avoid sending every boring frame for review.

nodes.label: Camera Handoff
nodes.full_label: Can a detector react before the object is gone? | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: Can a detector react before the object is gone?
nodes.summary: Local computing lets a station move from wide detection to focused tracking while a short-lived sky event is still visible.

nodes.label: Data Triage
nodes.full_label: Why sky stations cannot upload everything | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: Why sky stations cannot upload everything
nodes.summary: High-volume stations need local triage because continuous multimodal recording can create more data than reviewers can use.

nodes.full_label: Is the sky event real or the station misbehaving? | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: Is the sky event real or the station misbehaving?
nodes.summary: A station should test weather, clock, camera motion and sensor status before treating a strange recording as an unexplained event.

nodes.label: Pre Trigger
nodes.full_label: Why the seconds before a trigger matter | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: Why the seconds before a trigger matter
nodes.summary: A rolling buffer can turn a late trigger into a complete event record by preserving what happened just before the alert.

nodes.label: Trigger Rules
nodes.full_label: When should a sky station hit record? | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: When should a sky station hit record?
nodes.summary: A stronger trigger asks whether video, infrared, acoustic, radio, weather and aircraft data agree before an event is promoted.

nodes.label: UAPx Storage
nodes.full_label: What one UAPx week says about data overload | Automated Instrument 521443 Edge Computing
nodes.catchy_title: What one UAPx week says about data overload

nodes.label: False Positives

nodes.catchy_title: What Fools UFO Detectors Most Often?
nodes.summary: Most sky alarms are ordinary things, so detector pages need to explain the common impostors before the rare events.

nodes.catchy_title: The Satellite Check Every UFO Alert Needs

nodes.label: Local Ecology
nodes.full_label: Why Every UFO Camera Needs Local Wildlife Data | Automated Instrument 521443 False Positives
nodes.catchy_title: Why Every UFO Camera Needs Local Wildlife Data

nodes.label: Near lens Bugs
nodes.full_label: When Bugs Look Like Fast UFOs | Automated Instrument 521443 False Positives
nodes.catchy_title: When Bugs Look Like Fast UFOs

nodes.catchy_title: When Stars Turn Into Glowing Discs

nodes.catchy_title: How Starlink Trains Become UAP Reports

nodes.label: Thermal Birds
nodes.full_label: Why Birds Fool Infrared UFO Cameras | Automated Instrument 521443 False Positives
nodes.catchy_title: Why Birds Fool Infrared UFO Cameras

nodes.full_label: Should UAP Sensors Stay Put or Move? | Automated Instrument
nodes.catchy_title: Should UAP Sensors Stay Put or Move?

nodes.catchy_title: When Does a Fixed Station Earn Trust?

nodes.catchy_title: Why GREMLIN Watches the Ordinary First

nodes.catchy_title: Why Move a Detector to the Mystery?

nodes.catchy_title: What UAPx Learned the Hard Way
nodes.summary: The UAPx Catalina expedition showed that mobile multi-sensor work can collect rich data while still missing crucial corroboration.

nodes.catchy_title: Can the Station Create the Mystery?

nodes.catchy_title: Why Ordinary Aircraft Help Test Galileo

nodes.catchy_title: Can Galileo Catch Events Before They Vanish?

nodes.catchy_title: Why Galileo Does Not Take UFO Photos

nodes.catchy_title: When Weather Becomes a UAP Problem

nodes.catchy_title: Why Better Sensors Still See False UAPs

nodes.catchy_title: Why Sensitive Sites Complicate UAP Evidence
